answer: Under EigenTrust-style scoring, an exponential temporal half-life continually discounts stale interactions, so reputation must be earned through sustained honest service rather than accumulated once. A newly spawned sybil identity has little trusted history and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed trust from colluding peers. Like a comet briefly crossing a mirror’s view or an opal catching borrowed light, apparent activity alone cannot establish durable trust or pass consensus.
